name: SunDay Solar
old_description: In our fifteen years as a business we’ve shown thousands of customers how they can benefit from the power of the sun.
about:
SunDay Solar operates from Charlottesville, Virginia, where it has served residential and commercial customers for fifteen years as a locally owned, family-run business. The company was founded on the premise of guiding property owners through the transition to solar energy, handling every step from initial evaluation to final activation.

The firm designs and installs custom photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, including battery backup solutions such as the Enphase 10T. Its service division performs comprehensive system inspections, inverter and junction-box cleaning, wiring resealing, and critter-guard installation to protect against pest damage. Crews also manage all permitting, utility interconnection paperwork, and county inspections, and they provide ongoing monitoring with quarterly check-ins.

Customers range from homeowners seeking energy independence to small businesses and nonprofit organizations such as Feeding Greene, Inc. The company frequently services "orphaned" arrays whose original installers have ceased operations, diagnosing inverter faults and restoring production for systems it did not originally install.

SunDay Solar emphasizes a turnkey approach that bundles design, installation, permitting, and long-term monitoring under a single point of contact. A ten-year workmanship warranty and included quarterly monitoring are cited as core commitments, reflecting the founders' goal of remaining accountable throughout the system's lifespan.
